description_en: Queries the configurations of a UDP listener
name: DescribeLoadBalancerUDPListenerAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the SLB instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The frontend port used by the CLB instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例前端使用的端口。

取值：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

AclId.description_en: The ID of the access control policy group
The ID of the access control policy group

AclStatus.description_en: Indicates whether access control is enabled. Valid values: on or off (default)
AclStatus.description_zh: 是否开启访问控制功能。取值：on或off（默认值）

AclType.description_en:
The type of access control. Valid values:

white: Only requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the selected access control policy group are forwarded. Whitelists are applicable to scenarios in which you want to allow only specific IP addresses to access your application.

 Enabling a whitelist poses risks to your services. After you enable a whitelist, only the IP addresses in the whitelist can access the SLB listener. If a whitelist is enabled but no IP address is added to the access control policy group, the SLB listener forwards all requests.

black: All requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the selected access control policy group are not forwarded. Blacklists are applicable to scenarios in which you want to deny access from specific IP addresses to your application.
 
 If a blacklist is enabled but no IP address is added to the access control policy group, the SLB listener forwards all requests
AclType.description_zh:
访问控制类型：

white：仅转发来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的请求，白名单适用于应用只允许特定IP访问的场景。

 设置白名单存在一定业务风险。一旦设置白名单，就只有白名单中的IP可以访问负载均衡监听。如果开启了白名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求。

black：来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的所有请求都不会转发，黑名单适用于应用只限制某些特定IP访问的场景。
 
 如果开启了黑名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求

BackendServerPort.description_en:
The backend port used by the CLB instance.

This parameter is not returned if the backend server group is a vServer group
BackendServerPort.description_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例后端使用的端口。

如果后端服务器组为虚拟服务器组，则不返回该参数

Bandwidth.description_en:
The peak bandwidth of the listener. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values:

-1: For pay-by-traffic Internet-facing SLB instances, you can set the peak bandwidth to -1, which indicates that the peak bandwidth is not limited.

1 to 5120: For pay-by-bandwidth Internet-facing SLB instances, you can set the peak bandwidth for each listener. The sum of the peak bandwidth values of all listeners cannot exceed the peak bandwidth of the instance
Bandwidth.description_zh:
监听的带宽峰值，单位Mbps。取值：

-1：对于按流量计费的公网负载均衡实例，可以将带宽峰值设置为-1，即不限制带宽峰值。

1~5120：对于按带宽计费的公网负载均衡实例，可以设置每个监听的带宽峰值，但所有监听的带宽峰值之和不能超过实例的带宽峰值

HealthCheck.description_en:
Indicates whether health checks are enabled. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
HealthCheck.description_zh:
是否开启健康检查。取值：

on：开启。
off：关闭

HealthCheckConnectPort.description_en:
The port used for health checks. Valid values: 1 to 65535. If this parameter is not set, the backend service port (BackendServerPort) is used.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthCheckConnectPort.description_zh:
健康检查的端口。取值：1~65535。不设置此参数时，表示使用后端服务端口（BackendServerPort）。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

HealthCheckConnectTimeout.description_en: The maximum timeout period for waiting for a health check response. If the backend ECS instance does not respond correctly within the specified time, the health check fails. Valid values: 1 to 300. Unit: seconds
HealthCheckConnectTimeout.description_zh: 接收来自运行状况检查的响应需要等待的时间。如果后端ECS在指定的时间内没有正确响应，则判定为健康检查失败。取值：1~300秒

HealthCheckExp.description_en: The response string for UDP listener health checks. The string can contain only letters and digits, with a maximum length of 64 characters
HealthCheckExp.description_zh: UDP监听健康检查的响应串。只允许包含字母、数字，最大长度限制为64个字符

HealthCheckInterval.description_en: The interval between two consecutive health checks. Valid values: 1 to 50. Unit: seconds
HealthCheckInterval.description_zh: 健康检查的时间间隔，取值：1~50秒

HealthCheckReq.description_en: The request string for UDP listener health checks. The string can contain only letters and digits, with a maximum length of 64 characters
HealthCheckReq.description_zh: UDP监听健康检查的请求串。只允许包含字母、数字，最大长度限制为64个字符

HealthyThreshold.description_en: The healthy threshold. The number of consecutive successful health checks before a backend server is declared healthy, changing its health check status from failure to success. Valid values: 2 to 10
HealthyThreshold.description_zh: 健康检查阈值。健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由失败判定为成功。取值：2~10

ListenerPort.description_en: The frontend port used by the CLB instance
ListenerPort.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例前端使用的端口

LoadBalancerId.description_en: The ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance

MasterSlaveServerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the associated primary/secondary server group

ProxyProtocolV2Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether Proxy Protocol is used to carry the client source address to the backend server. Valid values:

true: Supported.
false: Not supported
ProxyProtocolV2Enabled.description_zh:
是否支持通过Proxy Protocol协议携带客户端源地址到后端服务器。取值：

true：是。
false：否

Scheduler.description_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:
wrr (default): Backend servers with higher weights receive more requests.

rr: Requests are distributed to backend servers in sequence
Scheduler.description_zh:
调度算法，取值：
wrr（默认值）：权重值越高的后端服务器，被轮询到的次数（概率）也越高。

rr：按照访问顺序依次将外部请求依序分发到后端服务器

Status.description_en:
The status of the listener. Valid values:

running: The listener is running.

stopped: The listener is stopped
Status.description_zh:
当前监听的状态。取值：

running：监听正常运行。

stopped：监听停止运行

TagKey.description_en: The tag key of the listener. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
TagKey.description_zh: 监听的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

TagValue.description_en: The tag value of the listener. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
TagValue.description_zh: 监听的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`

UnhealthyThreshold.description_en: The unhealthy threshold. The number of consecutive health check failures before a backend server is declared unhealthy, changing its health check status from success to failure. Valid values: 2 to 10
UnhealthyThreshold.description_zh: 不健康检查阈值。健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由成功判定为失败。取值：2~10

VServerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the vServer group attached to the listener
